propositions: Plan review must classify every acceptance-criterion item as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested and validate that the evidence kind matches its tag (exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] token selects ticket-attestation evidence; untagged or malformed tags default to codebase-verifiable).

Externally verifiable criteria missing the exact [operator-attested] tag or carrying malformed near-misses must produce findings with remediation syntax; conversely, codebase-verifiable criteria incorrectly tagged [operator-attested] must be flagged with explanation that comments cannot substitute for repository proof.

Criteria that bundle repository proof and outside-world proof must be detected and rejected with guidance to split into independently certifiable criteria, rather than silently assigned one evidence kind.

High-confidence misclassification findings must block under normal validity × impact policy while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory/fail-open; semantic judgment must reside in the criterion and evidence must be specific to each criterion, not keyword-only.

The new criterion must be routed through canonical registry, reviewer contract, criteria routing, generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md, and frozen evaluation corpus with no regression in existing completion-verifier behavior for exact-tag parsing and preservation of grounded signals.

Frozen-corpus evaluation must achieve 100% precision on genuine-external negatives, 100% recall on named test cases (A1, 115b/8c4f, malformed-tag, over-tagged-code fixtures), and macro precision/recall ≥0.90 across full corpus using production-equivalent model and workflow.
